description: Migration DDL: data-loss and rollback hazards per dialect — Classifies each statement of a PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQLite migration (up to 20000 characters) as reversible, needing a backup, needing the original definition, or irreversible, for agents that write or review schema migrations. Flags DROP TABLE/COLUMN, TRUNCATE, unbounded DELETE/UPDATE, lossy type changes, NOT NULL or constraints that fail on existing rows, table-rewrite and lock hazards, and MySQ
name: migration-reversibility
